# gallery

Good Enough Lab proofs of concept for Dr Gupta to consider.

```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gt)
```

## pictogram

```{r message=FALSE}
# get analyticals obs
source_sdg <- read_csv(here("pipeline/pipeline-data/source_sdg.csv"))

source_sdg |> gt()
```

## sort out layout

We want to lay out pic so that it imitates the UN SDG layout on the website.

```{r}
source_sdg |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_text(aes(
    x = x, y = y, label = sdg_int
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "UN SDG layout",
    y = "",
    x = ""
  )
```

## size by proportion of respondents

```{r}
# grab analytical layer

analytical_ranking_top_3 <- read_csv(here("pipeline/pipeline-data/analytical_ranking_top_3.csv"))
```

```{r}
plotdat <-
  analytical_ranking_top_3 |>
  select(respondent_id, sdg_id, ranking, region) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(
    n_respondents = n_distinct(respondent_id)
  ) |>
  group_by(region, sdg_id) |>
  summarise(
    respondents = n_distinct(respondent_id),
    total_respondents = mean(n_respondents)
  ) |>
  # shoot the laser
  drop_na() |>
  # really need to validate the aggrations but for now
  # chookity, shoot the laser
  left_join(source_sdg, by = "sdg_id") |>
  arrange(sdg_int) |>
  mutate(
    prop = respondents / total_respondents,
    percent_respondents = str_c(round(prop * 100)), " per cent"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(region, desc(prop))


gt::gt(
  plotdat |>
    select(region, sdg_id, sdg_text, respondents, total_respondents, percent_respondents) |>
    group_by(region) |>
    slice(1:3),
  groupname_col = "region"
)

plotdat |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_text(aes(
    x = x, y = y, label = sdg_int, colour = 1 - prop # , size = label_size
  ), size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "UN SDG layout",
    y = "",
    x = ""
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~region)
```

## experiment with a heatmap

Intention: x axis will be region, y axis sdg

```{r}
library(gt)

plotdat |>
  select(region, sdg_text, percent_respondents) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = region,
    values_from = percent_respondents
  ) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "sdg_text") |>
  data_color(
    columns = c(arunachal, tehri)
  )
```


## barplot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plotdat |>
  select(region, sdg_text, percent_respondents) |>
  mutate(percent_respondents = as.numeric(percent_respondents)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sdg_text, y = percent_respondents, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of Respondents",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```


```{r}

analytical_ranking_top_3 |>

  group_by(gender) |>
  summarise(

  )
```
